subject: Assigning colours to particular taxonomic ranks, unity across different plots

messages.author: 02b44df863e630dd
messages.subject: Assigning colours to particular taxonomic ranks, unity across different plots
parts:
Hello,

I using DeSeq2 in phyloseq to create dotplots following this tutorial http://joey711.github.io/phyloseq-extensions/DESeq2.html 
This works great using the following code however I am struggling with colour.
The dots are coloured according to the order they come from however when trying to make plots for different pairings due to the fact that different orders are present colours dont match across individual graphs.

How can I controls which order each colour is assigned to, rather than colours being randomly assigned?
For example also make points belonging to Bacteroidales red and Clostridiales purple.

library("ggplot2")

theme_set(theme_bw())

scale_fill_discrete <- function(palname = "Set1", ...) {

scale_fill_brewer(palette = palname, ...)

}

# Order order

x = tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Order, function(x) max(x))

x = sort(x, TRUE)

sigtab$Order = factor(as.character(sigtab$Order), levels=names(x))

# Genus order

x = tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Genus, function(x) max(x))

x = sort(x, TRUE)

sigtab$Genus = factor(as.character(sigtab$Genus), levels=names(x))

ggplot(sigtab, aes(x=Genus, y=log2FoldChange, color=Order)) + geom_point(size=6) +

theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust=0.5))


Dot_plot_UN_LS1 <- ggplot(sigtab, aes(x=Genus, y=log2FoldChange, color=Order)) + geom_point(size=6) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust=0.5))


Dot_plot_UN_LS1 + ggtitle("Differentially abundant OTUs (uninfected vs LS 1)") + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))


Any help much appreciated,

Cheers,

Sarah
